attributes.residual: 3 instructions in a 77-instruction function. Baseline retained: real 7, insns T77/O76, multiset DIFFERS(3t). NAMED MECHANISM, not allocator noise: the target emits the forward unfused pair 'bge ->0xd8; b ->0xf4' and keeps the conditional's result in r4 -- the SAME register that holds the local 'node' -- so its else-arm is genuinely empty and the body tail carries the assignment copy 'mr r4,r0' at 0xf0. The only C form that reproduces the pair is the arm-swapped ternary, and MWCC will not unify a ternary's result register with the local being assigned: it allocated r0, pushing the copy 'mr r0,r4' into the empty arm at 0xd4 and leaving the store reading r0 (real 7 -> 18 despite EXACT count parity 77/77 and an IDENTICAL opcode multiset -- arbitrated as a CONFLICT and rejected on the finer metric). Forcing unification by redundant self-assignment spills node to the stack (real 85, insns 78). DO NOT RETRY: goto/if/else statement spellings (measured byte-identical), ternary arm order (reaches multiset 0t but costs the register), self-assignment unification (spills). The remaining open axis for a future session is whether a source shape exists in which 'node' is consumed directly by the following store rather than assigned back to a live local -- e.g. if the target's local is dead after the store, a different local layout might let the allocator pick r4 for the ternary result.
